channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: United Kingdom Unemployment Rate stays at 4.9% in June vs. 4.8% expected
item.description: The United Kingdom’s (UK) ILO Unemployment Rate stayed at 4.9% in the three months to June after reporting 4.9% in the previous reading, data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Tuesday. The data came in above the market consensus of 4.8%.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds weak footing ahead of looming BI policy decision
item.description: USD/IDR remains in the positive territory after experiencing volatility, trading around 17,900 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair continues to draw support from a weakening Indonesian Rupiah (IDR), driven by cautious domestic sentiment ahead of Bank Indonesia’s (BI) two-day policy meeting.

item.title: Swiss Franc edges lower as US Dollar rebounds, FOMC minutes in focus
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) in the early European trading session on Tuesday, with the USD/CHF pair edging up to near 0.8116.

item.title: Indian Rupee ticks up on possible RBI’s intervention
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) edges up against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR ticks lower to near 95.67 after refreshing the three-week high at 95.85 in the opening session. The Indian currency has gained slight strength due to potential Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) intervention.

item.title: Euro declines below 1.1600 on US-Iran war worries
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses traction to around 1.1575, snapping the three-day winning streak during the early European session on Tuesday. The Euro (EUR) edges lower against the US Dollar (USD) as traders remain cautious about the US-Iran conflict and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Gold slides below $4,400 as oil-fueled inflation risks and US-Iran tensions bolster USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its intraday descent and slides back below the $4,400 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar bulls seem hesitant near 0.7100 as USD recovers from two-month low
item.description: The AUD/USD pair turns lower following a modest Asian session uptick on Tuesday, awaiting a break below the 0.7100 mark before extending the previous day's retracement from the highest level since June 5.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises to near 185.00 after breaking above 50-day EMA
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its winning streak for the fourth successive day, trading around 184.80 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens to near 113.50, near-term outlook remain constructive
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 113.40 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) amid mounting fiscal concerns and persistent inflationary pressures.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls retain near two-week top, above $84.00 and 38.2% Fibo.
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – enters a bullish consolidation phase after hitting an over two-week high during the Asian session on Tuesday and currently trades around the $84.20 region.

item.title: UKMTO reports incident in the Strait of Hormuz — Reuters
item.description: The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said that it has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen remains near two-week low against US Dollar despite hawkish BoJ bets
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades close to its two-week low against the US Dollar (USD) in the Asian trading session on Tuesday at around 159.50. The USD/JPY pair is under pressure even as financial markets are confident about a Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate hike in the September meeting.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds ground on safe-haven demand
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is inching higher after three days of losses and trading around 99.60 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar edges lower below 0.5900 as China’s economy slows in July
item.description: The NZD/USD pair declines to around 0.5895 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. Weaker-than-expected Chinese Retail Sales and Industrial Production data weigh on the China-proxy New Zealand Dollar (NZD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $65.50 amid US-Iran peace uncertainty
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) declines after two days of gains, trading around $65.60 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar holds near early June high as rising oil prices offset modest USD strength
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to build on the overnight bounce from the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) support near the 1.3845 region, or the lowest level since June 3, and is seen consolidating during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: British Pound gathers strength to near 1.3550 as Fed hike bets fade, UK jobs data loom
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains momentum to around 1.3550 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) as cooler US inflation data have prompted traders to reduce bets on a US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7905 vs. 6.7873 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.7905 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7873 and 6.7452 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro flat lines below two-month high as oil-driven inflation fears support USD
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds steady around the 1.1575-1.1580 region during the Asian session on Tuesday and, for now, seems to have stalled the previous day's modest pullback from a two-month top.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains as US Dollar struggles amid fading Fed rate hike bets
item.description: AUD/USD extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 0.7110 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency pair continues to appreciate as the US Dollar (USD) remains subdued amid fading expectations for further rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: WTI flatlines near $84.00 as Trump rejects truce extension
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $84.00 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. WTI steadies as traders continue to assess the developments surrounding Middle East conflicts.

item.title: US President Donald Trump says not seeking extension of Iran MOU
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that he is not interested in renewing the expiring agreement with Iran, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

item.title: Gold gains momentum above $4,400 as softer US data dampens Fed hike odds
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) edges higher to near $4,415 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal extends its upside amid fading expectations for further US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes. Traders will closely monitor the developments surrounding the Middle East conflicts.

item.title: Australian Dollar climbs as the Greenback falls on soft US data
item.description: The Aussie Dollar trades near two-month highs of 0.7129, supported by a weaker US Dollar, amid a scarce economic docket in the US, following last week’s softer Retail Sales data. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7106, up 0.32%.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Bulls reclaim 50-day SMA, eye 217.00
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross-pair is poised to finish Monday’s session with gains of over 0.14% as traders prepare for the beginning of Tuesday’s Asian session. The cross-pair has climbed above the 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at 215.52, often seen as a breakout that opens the door to further upside.

item.title: The Japanese Yen is losing to its own import bill
item.description: USD/JPY sat near 159.50 through Monday inside a 75-pip range for a net gain of 10 pips, on the day the Dollar Index broke beneath its 200-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) to its weakest level since June.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Struggles at 1.1600, dives below 100-day SMA
item.description: The shared currency clings to minimal gains versus the US Dollar on Monday, edging up by some 0.08% after reaching a month-and-a-half high at 1.1614, then reversing course and falling beneath 1.1600, poised to end the session near the low of the day (LOD) of 1.1561.

item.title: British Pound Sterling did not earn its three-month high
item.description: GBP/USD cleared 1.3550 on Monday for the first time in three months, printed the highest level of the window just above it and handed the entire advance back within hours for a net gain under 10 pips. Sterling did none of the work behind that number.

item.title: US Treasury yields surge as 30-year hits 2007 high
item.description: US Treasury yields advance on Monday during the North American session after reversing their course following the release of US Retail Sales data last week, which disappointed investors.
